direct_error_sources: exact declared ErrorSet of a non-inferred callee
exact function-type ErrorSet of an indirect call

recursive_substitution_law.comparison_key: the complete SubstitutionId normalized after alias expansion and associated-binding normalization
recursive_substitution_law.inferred_scc_edge_admitted: caller and callee have exactly the same normalized substitution vector
recursive_substitution_law.required_repair: declare an explicit throws row on the recursive callable boundary

algorithm.name: PrivateErrorInferenceV1
steps: build the finite directed graph of admitted inferred callable instances
before adding a recursive inferred edge, require exact equality of caller and callee normalized substitution vectors; reject every different or expansive vector and require explicit throws
sort nodes and edges by stable semantic identity, never source order
initialize each component with all normalized direct and explicit-callee ErrorIds
process the component DAG in reverse topological order and union successor rows
iterate union inside each component to the finite least fixed point
validate every inferred ErrorId against the effective visibility of every exposed caller
seal one normalized ErrorSetId and inference proof digest per callable instance
algorithm.termination_measure: finite callable declarations times one normalized substitution vector per admitted recursive inferred SCC times the finite normalized ErrorId universe

normalization.api_rule: no inferred ErrorId may escape a visibility domain that cannot name it
normalization.mir_rule: consume the sealed HIR ErrorSetId; never rerun inference

acceptance.positive: an acyclic private caller or same-substitution recursive caller receives the exact union of its direct and callee ErrorIds
acceptance.boundary: aliases normalize before comparing recursive substitution vectors, so an equal-vector mutually recursive private SCC has one source-order-independent finite union
acceptance.reject: a non-admitted omission, unsealed call edge, different or expansive recursive substitution vector, or private ErrorId leak emits one primary diagnostic and seals no canonical HIR callable
